description: This file contains the implementation of the Twig Lexer class responsible for tokenizing Twig templates. It defines tokenization rules, regex patterns, and parsing logic for different template elements such as data, blocks, variables, strings, and interpolations.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Implements tokenization for Twig templates, converting template source code into a stream of tokens based on defined regex patterns and state management.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Main method to generate a token stream from a Twig Source object.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes regex patterns and sets up lexer state; called lazily during tokenization.

methods.name: pushToken
methods.description: Adds a token to the tokens array, optionally with a value.

methods.name: moveCursor
methods.description: Advances the cursor position in the source code, updating line number count.

methods.name: pushState
methods.description: Pushes current state onto the stack and sets a new lexer state.

methods.name: popState
methods.description: Restores the previous lexer state from the stack.
